import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs/task-8f91afb7.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Move each connected component toward the lower edge, keeping its color and shape.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
          col=grid[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
          while stack:
            y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
              q=(y+dy,x+dx)
              if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==col:
                seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
          comps.append((col,cells))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # Process lower components first; each falls until blocked.
    comps.sort(key=lambda z:max(r for r,c in z[1]), reverse=True)
    for col,cells in comps:
      shift=0
      while True:
        nxt=shift+1
        if any(r+nxt>=h or (out[r+nxt][c] not in (0,col)) for r,c in cells): break
        shift=nxt
      for r,c in cells: out[r+shift][c]=col
    return out
'''
